import argparse

from notes import core


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="notes")
    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    add = sub.add_parser("add")
    add.add_argument("text")
    sub.add_parser("list")
    args = p.parse_args()
    if args.cmd == "add":
        core.add(args.text)
    else:
        for n in core.load():
            print(n)
